messages:
auditor_clara: Hi team, auditor follow-up: we need end-to-end artifacts for an RBAC tweak affecting the serviceAccount `inference-sidecar` on 2025-05-07. Ask: (1) PR/commit that made the change, (2) exact deploy timestamps, (3) KMS Decrypt events for alias rdw-inference-key around the deploy, and (4) any vuln/ops notes that explain why the change happened. Where should we pull these from?

nate_oncall: Hi @auditor_clara — PR + CI artifact + CloudTrail + k8s audit should cover it. We can bundle and sign.

veda_infra: PR is github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4812, merge commit a1b2c3d (merged 2025-05-07T11:02:05Z). CI job 9842 applied `kubectl apply -f rollout-sidecar-20250507.yaml` at 2025-05-07T11:02:37Z. I saved CI artifact `deploy-sidecar-20250507-1102.json` to s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/05/07/deploy-sidecar-20250507-1102.json

priya_sec: For KMS: query CloudTrail for eventName=Decrypt and requestParameters.keyId containing `rdw-inference-key` between 2025-05-07T11:00:00Z and 2025-05-07T11:10:00Z. Example Splunk query we use:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext, sourceIPAddress
```

auditor_clara: Will the CloudTrail records let us prove the decrypt was requested by the service account vs the node role?

priya_sec: Yes. Our client sets encryptionContext with `service_account=inference-sidecar` when calling KMS. CloudTrail shows the assumed role in userIdentity.principalId but requestParameters.encryptionContext ties the call to the service account. That is the authoritative linkage for auditors.

veda_infra: Also saving a k8s audit snippet that shows the serviceAccount binding: s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/05/07/sa-binding-sidecar-1102.json. It includes the exact verb and object on the service account.

nate_oncall: I'll run the exporter: `auditpack bundle --from 2025-05-07T11:00:00Z --to 2025-05-07T11:10:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --out s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1768008888-sidecar-bundle.tar.gz`

evidence-bot: Evidence export started by nate_oncall. Job ID ebnd-45f1.

priya_sec: Vulnerability note: INFSEC-1244 (linked in PR) — patched protobuf dependency after SAST flagged potential input-parsing issue. No active exploit observed. Triage summary `INFSEC-1244-summary.txt` will be included.

auditor_clara: Please include a short timeline (10s granularity) that ties the merge -> CI -> k8s rollout -> decrypt events so we can demonstrate causality. Also list authoritative paths for each artifact and state what redactions were applied.

nate_oncall: Exporter will generate `timeline.csv` with `_time,artifact,detail` at 10s resolution when available. I'll add `mapping.txt` that lists each artifact and its S3/GitHub path and a short attestation `attestation.txt` signed by oncall.

priya_sec: Redactions: we strip hostnames and customer IPs; we keep principal ARNs, encryptionContext values, and serviceAccount names. Checksums for each artifact are attached in `checksums.sha256`.

evidence-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1768008888-sidecar-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: e7c9f4...)

auditor_clara: Received. I'll review tomorrow and open any follow-ups if raw CloudTrail is needed. Thanks all :thumbsup:

veda_infra: For the record we also captured a pod env snapshot at 11:02 (internal-only): s3://redwood-audit/forensics/pod-env-sidecar-20250507-1102.json — available if you need process context.

nate_oncall: Marking this resolved unless auditor requests deeper traces.

auditor_clara: Acknowledged, thanks again.
